dashboard.label: P9 — Splunk SOC Operations Dashboard
dashboard.description: Unified Enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC) Dashboard: Centralized tactical visibility across Authentication, Endpoint Security, Network Threats, Web Attacks, Brute-Force Activity, Alert Triage, and Investigation Timelines (Grounded in P1–P8 Telemetry).

search.query: (index=windows) OR (index=sysmon) OR (index=linux_security) OR (index=web) OR (index=email) earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | stats count

(index=windows EventCode IN (4624, 4625, 4672) earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=linux_security sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Accepted") earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | stats count

(index=windows earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=linux_security earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=web earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=email earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | eval is_threat=case( EventCode=4625 OR match(_raw, "(?i)Failed password"), 1, index="web" AND (status>=400 OR match(_raw, "(?i)(union\s+select|<script|\.\./|nikto|sqlmap)")), 1, index="sysmon" AND (match(CommandLine, "(?i)(certutil|bitsadmin|mshta|-enc|bypass|psexec|whoami|schtasks)") OR EventID=22), 1, EventCode IN (4728, 4732, 7045), 1, index="linux_security" AND match(_raw, "(?i)(NOT in sudoers|authentication failure)"), 1, index="email" AND match(_raw, "(?i)(urgent|password|wire transfer|\.xlsm|\.iso|\.exe)"), 1, true(), 0 ) | where is_threat=1 | stats count
index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | search EventID=3 | stats count
index=web sourcetype=access_combined earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | stats count

(index=windows earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=linux_security earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=web earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | eval is_crit_high=case( Logon_Type="9", 1, match(CommandLine, "(?i)(-(enc|encodedcommand)\s+|mshta.*http|psexesvc)"), 1, match(_raw, "(?i)(union\s+select.*from|<script>.*alert|\.iso|\.pdf\.exe)"), 1, EventCode IN (4728, 4732), 1, true(), 0 ) | where is_crit_high=1 | stats count

(index=windows (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4625) earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=linux_security sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Accepted") earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | eval auth_status=case( EventCode=4624, "Successful Windows", EventCode=4625, "Failed Windows", index="linux_security" AND match(_raw, "(?i)Accepted"), "Successful Linux SSH", index="linux_security" AND match(_raw, "(?i)Failed password"), "Failed Linux SSH", true(), "Other" ) | stats count by auth_status

chart.title: Logon Volume over Time (Success vs. Failure)

search.query: (index=windows (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4625) earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=linux_security sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Accepted") earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | eval outcome=case( EventCode=4624 OR match(_raw, "(?i)Accepted"), "Success", EventCode=4625 OR match(_raw, "(?i)Failed password"), "Failure", true(), "Other" ) | timechart span=1h count by outcome

(index=windows (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4625) earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=linux_security sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Accepted") earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | rex field=_raw "Failed password for (?:invalid user )?(?<linux_fail_user>[^\s]+)" | rex field=_raw "Accepted \w+ for (?<linux_succ_user>[^\s]+)" | eval TargetAccount=lower(coalesce(TargetUserName, linux_fail_user, linux_succ_user, user, Account_Name)) | search isnotnull(TargetAccount) AND NOT TargetAccount IN ("*$", "anonymous logon", "system", "local service", "network service") | eval is_fail=if(EventCode=4625 OR isnotnull(linux_fail_user), 1, 0) | eval is_succ=if(EventCode=4624 OR isnotnull(linux_succ_user), 1, 0) | stats sum(is_fail) as Failures, sum(is_succ) as Successes, values(host) as Hosts by TargetAccount | sort - Failures, - Successes

(index=windows EventCode=4625 earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=linux_security sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | rex field=_raw "Failed password for (?:invalid user )?(?<linux_user>[^\s]+) from (?<linux_src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | eval TargetUser=lower(coalesce(TargetUserName, linux_user, user, Account_Name)) | eval SourceIP=coalesce(IpAddress, linux_src_ip, SourceNetworkAddress, src_ip) | search isnotnull(TargetUser) AND NOT TargetUser IN ("*$", "anonymous logon") AND isnotnull(SourceIP) AND NOT SourceIP IN ("127.0.0.1", "::1", "-") | bin _time span=5m | stats count as failure_count, dc(TargetUser) as distinct_users, values(TargetUser) as targeted_users by _time, SourceIP, host | where failure_count>=5 OR distinct_users>=3 | eval attack_pattern=if(distinct_users>=3, "Password Spraying (T1110.003)", "Targeted Brute-Force (T1110.001)") | eval _time=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - failure_count

panel.title: SECTION 3: ENDPOINT SECURITY — Windows Telemetry Distribution

search.query: (index=windows earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<SysmonEventID>\d+)</EventID>" | eval UnifiedID=case( isnotnull(EventCode), "Win Event " . EventCode, isnotnull(SysmonEventID), "Sysmon EID " . SysmonEventID, true(), "Other" ) | top limit=8 UnifiedID

panel.title: SECTION 3: ENDPOINT SECURITY — Suspicious Process & LOLBin Activity

table.title: Suspicious CLI, LOLBins & Obfuscated PowerShell (T1059 / T1218)

search.query: index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | search EventID=1 | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='Image'>(?<Image>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='User'>(?<User>[^<]+)</Data>" | eval process_name=lower(replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "")) | eval threat_finding=case( match(CommandLine, "(?i)powershell.*-(e|en|enc|encodedcommand)\s+"), "CRITICAL: Obfuscated PowerShell Dropper (T1059.001)", process_name="certutil.exe" AND match(CommandLine, "(?i)(-urlcache|-split)"), "HIGH: Certutil Remote Download (T1105 / LOLBin)", process_name="bitsadmin.exe" AND match(CommandLine, "(?i)(/transfer|/create)"), "HIGH: Bitsadmin Ingress Staging (T1105 / LOLBin)", match(CommandLine, "(?i)schtasks.*create"), "HIGH: Scheduled Task CLI Persistence (T1053.005)", match(CommandLine, "(?i)(whoami.*priv|net\s+user)"), "MEDIUM: Discovery Reconnaissance Burst (T1082)", true(), "NORMAL" ) | where threat_finding!="NORMAL" | stats count as Executions, values(CommandLine) as CommandLine, values(User) as User, latest(_time) as LastSeen by threat_finding, process_name | eval LastSeen=strftime(LastSeen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - Executions
index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | search EventID=3 | timechart span=1h count as Connections

panel.title: SECTION 4: NETWORK SECURITY — Suspicious Port Egress

search.query: index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | search EventID=3 | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='Image'>(?<Image>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='DestinationIp'>(?<DestinationIp>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='DestinationPort'>(?<DestinationPort>[^<]+)</Data>" | eval risk=case( DestinationPort IN ("4444", "1337", "31337", "5555"), "CRITICAL: Known Backdoor / Metasploit Port", DestinationPort IN ("5985", "5986"), "HIGH: WinRM Management Traffic", DestinationPort="3389", "MEDIUM: Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP)", DestinationPort="445", "MEDIUM: Server Message Block (SMB)", true(), "NORMAL" ) | where risk!="NORMAL" | eval binary=lower(replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "")) | stats count as Connections, values(DestinationIp) as DestinationIPs, values(binary) as InitiatingBinaries by risk, DestinationPort | sort - Connections

chart.title: Web Attacks by OWASP Top 10 Category

search.query: index=web sourcetype=access_combined earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | eval attack_type=case( match(uri_query, "(?i)(union(\s+|\/\*.*\*\/)+select|information_schema)"), "SQL Injection (SQLi)", match(uri_query, "(?i)(<script|javascript:|alert\()"), "Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)", match(uri_path, "(?i)(\.\./|/etc/passwd)"), "Path / Directory Traversal", match(useragent, "(?i)(nikto|sqlmap|dirbuster|nmap)"), "Automated Web Scanner", status>=500, "Internal Server Error (5xx)", status=404, "Not Found (404 Recon)", true(), "Normal Request" ) | where attack_type!="Normal Request" | top limit=6 attack_type

panel.title: SECTION 5: WEB SECURITY — HTTP Response Trends

search.query: index=web sourcetype=access_combined earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | eval status_tier=case( status>=200 AND status<300, "2xx Success", status>=300 AND status<400, "3xx Redirect", status>=400 AND status<500, "4xx Client Error", status>=500, "5xx Server Error", true(), "Other" ) | timechart span=1h count by status_tier

panel.title: SECTION 6: THREAT DETECTION — Rule Catalog & MITRE Mapping

search.query: (index=windows) OR (index=sysmon) OR (index=linux_security) OR (index=web) OR (index=email) earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | eval detection=case( match(uri_query, "(?i)(union(\s+|\/\*.*\*\/)+select)"), "DET-P6-01: SQL Injection (T1190)", match(uri_query, "(?i)(<script|javascript:)"), "DET-P6-02: XSS Injection (T1190)", match(uri_path, "(?i)(\.\./|/etc/passwd)"), "DET-P6-03: Directory Traversal (T1083)", match(CommandLine, "(?i)powershell.*-(e|enc)\s+"), "DET-P8-01: Obfuscated PowerShell (T1059.001)", match(CommandLine, "(?i)(certutil.*-urlcache|bitsadmin.*(/transfer|/create))"), "DET-P8-02: LOLBin Ingress (T1105)", match(CommandLine, "(?i)schtasks.*create") OR (EventID IN (12,13) AND match(_raw, "(?i)\\\\Run\\\\")), "DET-P8-03: Autostart Persistence (T1547.001)", EventID=22 AND match(_raw, "(?i)duckdns\.org"), "DET-P8-04: Dynamic DNS C2 (T1071.004)", EventCode=4625 OR match(_raw, "(?i)Failed password"), "DET-P4-01: Authentication Brute Force (T1110)", true(), "NORMAL" ) | where detection!="NORMAL" | rex field=detection "^(?<RuleID>[^:]+):\s+(?<DetectionName>.*?)\s+\((?<MITRE>[^\)]+)\)$" | stats count as TriggerCount, dc(host) as AffectedHosts by RuleID, DetectionName, MITRE | sort - TriggerCount

(index=windows) OR (index=sysmon) OR (index=linux_security) OR (index=web) OR (index=email) earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | eval severity=case( match(uri_query, "(?i)(union(\s+|\/\*.*\*\/)+select)") OR match(CommandLine, "(?i)-(e|enc)\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}") OR Logon_Type="9", "CRITICAL", match(uri_query, "(?i)(<script|\.\./)") OR match(CommandLine, "(?i)(certutil.*-urlcache|bitsadmin.*create|schtasks.*create)") OR EventID=3, "HIGH", EventCode=4625 OR match(_raw, "(?i)Failed password") OR EventID=22, "MEDIUM", true(), "NO_ALERT" ) | where severity!="NO_ALERT" | stats count by severity

panel.title: SECTION 8: UNIFIED INVESTIGATION TIMELINE — Chronological Incident Stream

table.title: Chronological SOC Event Correlation Stream (Source IP, User, Activity, Severity, MITRE)

search.query: (index=windows (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4672 OR EventCode=4728 OR EventCode=7045) earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=linux_security earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=web sourcetype=access_combined earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<SysmonEventID>\d+)</EventID>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='SourceIp'>(?<sysmon_src_ip>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "from (?<linux_src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | rex field=_raw "Failed password for (?:invalid user )?(?<linux_fail_user>[^\s]+)" | rex field=_raw "Accepted \w+ for (?<linux_succ_user>[^\s]+)" | eval SourceIP=coalesce(clientip, IpAddress, sysmon_src_ip, linux_src_ip, SourceNetworkAddress, src_ip, "N/A") | eval TargetAccount=lower(coalesce(TargetUserName, linux_fail_user, linux_succ_user, user, Account_Name, "N/A")) | eval EventTriage=case( match(uri_query, "(?i)(union(\s+|\/\*.*\*\/)+select)"), "Web: SQL Injection Attack (T1190)", match(uri_query, "(?i)(<script|javascript:)"), "Web: Cross-Site Scripting (T1190)", match(uri_path, "(?i)(\.\./|/etc/passwd)"), "Web: Directory Traversal (T1083)", match(useragent, "(?i)(nikto|sqlmap|nmap)"), "Recon: Automated Web Scanner (T1595.002)", match(CommandLine, "(?i)powershell.*-(e|en|enc|encodedcommand)\s+"), "Endpoint: Obfuscated PowerShell (T1059.001)", match(CommandLine, "(?i)(certutil.*-urlcache|bitsadmin.*create)"), "Endpoint: LOLBin Ingress Transfer (T1105)", match(CommandLine, "(?i)schtasks.*create"), "Persistence: Scheduled Task Creation (T1053.005)", SysmonEventID IN (12,13) AND match(_raw, "(?i)\\\\Run\\\\"), "Persistence: Registry Autostart Modification (T1547.001)", SysmonEventID=22 AND match(_raw, "(?i)duckdns\.org"), "C2: Dynamic DNS Query Beacon (T1071.004)", EventCode=4625, "Auth: Windows Logon Failure (T1110)", isnotnull(linux_fail_user), "Auth: Linux SSH Logon Failure (T1110)", EventCode=4624 AND Logon_Type="9", "PrivEsc: Pass-The-Hash / NewCredentials (T1550.002)", EventCode IN (4728, 4732), "PrivEsc: Group Membership Alteration (T1098)", true(), "NORMAL" ) | where EventTriage!="NORMAL" | eval Severity=case( match(EventTriage, "(?i)(SQL Injection|Pass-The-Hash|Obfuscated PowerShell|Group Membership)"), "CRITICAL", match(EventTriage, "(?i)(Cross-Site|Directory Traversal|LOLBin|Persistence)"), "HIGH", true(), "MEDIUM" ) | eval ActivityDetail=coalesce(CommandLine, uri_query, uri_path, _raw) | table _time, Severity, EventTriage, SourceIP, TargetAccount, host, ActivityDetail | eval _time=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - _time
